# g14 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 10
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, ..., 10

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{10} c_i x_i
```
where c = [1, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 1.8, 1.9]

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = - \sum_{i=1}^{10} x_i + 1 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = \sum_{i=1}^{10} x_i^2 - 1/3 \leq 0
```
```math
g_3(x) = - \prod_{i=1}^{10} x_i + 2.5 \times 10^{-5} \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -47.764888
